layer: Compiled local service and built renderer
limits: Disposable fictional pack and POSIX file-permission failure; no live worker/provider or native Windows proof
checks: Rendered upload preview is read-only and requires confirmation; real upgrade merges publisher change with staff title, adds optional plan, pauses approvals/schedules, and reconciles lost response without another generation.
A competing edit to the same plan field produces a visible conflict and cannot be applied.
A real protected-directory write failure leaves durable intent and paused plans; after cold service restart, Resume completes the exact saved change.

Reviewed rollback restores prior instructions and staff configuration as a new generation; optional plan history stays saved and reactivation and execution are both refused; prior published definition exports exactly.

At eight retained configurations the UI previews six for archival and keeps two recent; a real EACCES write failure preserves every configuration and all approval/schedule bytes. Cold restart and lost-response resume commit one archive without another generation.

A new update succeeds after archival; retrying the original archive after that update makes no changes. The rendered archived configuration rolls back through normal review and retired-plan ownership remains enforced.

Actual service SIGKILL after a partial archive write leaves durable intent and original history; mobile cold-resume repairs that staging file and removes it. A second archive retains the first batch; bounded older-page browsing still reaches configuration one. Desktop and mobile archival screens remain usable.
Desktop and390px screens render without horizontal overflow, browser errors or off-origin requests; private business book bytes remain unchanged.
